cards.headline: Efficacy and safety of antibiotic-loaded bone cement in the treatment of diabetic foot

source.title: Efficacy and safety of antibiotic-loaded bone cement in the treatment of diabetic foot: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.publisher: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
source.excerpt: Antibiotic-loaded bone cement (ALBC) therapy demonstrates significant efficacy and safety in managing diabetic foot ulcers, promoting rapid tissue regeneration while minimizing adverse effects.

cards.headline: Agentic AI in transforming agriculture: a review

source.title: Agentic AI in transforming agriculture: a review.
source.excerpt: This Review examines the rise of these systems in agriculture and outlines research priorities for their development and deployment.

cards.headline: Stangeria eriopus

source.title: Stangeria eriopus
source.excerpt: Stangeria eriopus ist eine Pflanzenart der Palmfarne (Cycadales); sie ist die einzige Art der monotypischen Gattung Stangeria. Die Art ist endemisch in einem schmalen Streifen an der Ostküste Südafrikas und dem südlichen Mosambik. Stangeria eriopus ist ein sehr langlebiger, ausdauernder, immergrüner Palmfarn.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in gastroenterology clinical practice

source.title: Artificial intelligence in gastroenterology clinical practice: Scoping review of large language model applications.
source.excerpt: Research on LLMs in gastroenterology has expanded across multiple subspecialties and application domains. Current evidence is primarily based on simulation studies, with limited but growing evaluation using real-world clinical data.

cards.headline: Riesenmaulhai

source.title: Riesenmaulhai
source.excerpt: Der Riesenmaulhai ist neben Walhai und Riesenhai eine der drei zurzeit bekannten Haiarten, die sich von Kleinstlebewesen ernähren. Seit seiner Entdeckung im Jahre 1976 ist er die einzige Art in der nur aus einer Gattung bestehenden Familie der Riesenmaulhaie.

cards.headline: Early pregnancy biomarkers for gestational diabetes mellitus prediction

source.title: Early pregnancy biomarkers for gestational diabetes mellitus prediction: a systematic review and meta-analysis of routine laboratory, metabolic, and inflammatory markers.
source.excerpt: Early pregnancy biomarkers show moderate to high diagnostic accuracy for GDM prediction. However, high heterogeneity and limited data on integrated multi-marker panels constrain clinical application. Standardization of protocols and validation in diverse populations are needed.

cards.headline: Helmut Fischer

source.title: Helmut Fischer
source.excerpt: Helmut Fischer war ein deutscher Schauspieler, der vor allem durch seine Rollen als bayerischer Volksschauspieler bekannt wurde. Er verkörperte in seinen Rollen den charmanten Hallodri und Vorstadt-Casanova. Fischers Markenzeichen war sein staksiger Gang, der mit einem Bandscheibenschaden zusammenhing. Besondere Popularität erlangte Fischer in der Rolle des Münchner Originals Monaco Franze.

cards.headline: Global hotspots and trends in the application of neoadjuvant therapy for gastric cancer

source.title: Global hotspots and trends in the application of neoadjuvant therapy for gastric cancer: a bibliometric analysis.
source.excerpt: We used bibliometrics to conduct a visual analysis of the application of NAT in GC. Research hotspots include diverse NAT strategies, open-label trials and survival outcomes, and technology empowerment.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence across oncologic theranostics

source.title: Artificial intelligence across oncologic theranostics: evidence for patient stratification, dosimetry, and adaptive radiopharmaceutical therapy.
source.excerpt: An eight-domain RPT evidence-to-decision synthesis organizes quantitative fidelity, reference standards, validation, endpoints, biological linkage, oversight, uncertainty and quality assurance, and decision impact; it is not a validated score or adoption standard.

cards.headline: Association between hypothyroidism and risk of chronic kidney disease

source.title: Association between hypothyroidism and risk of chronic kidney disease: evidence from a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: This systematic review and meta-analysis suggests that hypothyroidism is associated with an increased risk of CKD. Future well-designed prospective and interventional studies are needed to clarify temporal and causal relationships and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms between hypothyroidism and renal dysfunction.

cards.headline: Single-arm meta-analysis on robotic spine instrumentation for young patients

source.title: Single-arm meta-analysis on robotic spine instrumentation for young patients.
source.publisher: European journal of orthopaedic surgery & traumatology : orthopedie traumatologie
source.excerpt: RAS demonstrates high pedicle screw accuracy and safety in pediatric and adolescent spine surgery, with low rates of extreme screw misplacement. Adoption of this technology requires overcoming current limitations.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in drug discovery

source.title: Artificial intelligence in drug discovery: from algorithmic foundations to clinical translation.
source.excerpt: As AI continues to mature, it will reshape drug development in ways we are only beginning to grasp, but one truth remains stubborn: clinical translation still rests on rigorous experimental evidence.

cards.headline: Postoperative radiotherapy for resected esophageal squamous cell carcinoma

source.title: Postoperative radiotherapy for resected esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: For patients with radically resected ESCC, PORT significantly improves OS and DFS and reduces LRR, especially in those with high-risk features. A radiation dose of 50 Gy is recommended to achieve optimal benefit. Although PORT increases acute toxicity, it is generally manageable.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Musculoskeletal Imaging

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Musculoskeletal Imaging: Innovations and Clinical Impact in Rheumatology.
source.publisher: Rheumatic diseases clinics of North America
source.excerpt: Future applications include improved prognostic modeling and identifying candidates for targeted interventions and clinical trials.

cards.headline: Was nun diejenigen angeht, die ungläubig sind …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:56
source.excerpt: فأمَّا الذين كفروا بالمسيح من اليهود أو غَلَوا فيه من النصارى، فأعذبهم عذابًا شديدًا في الدنيا: بالقتل وسلْبِ الأموال وإزالة الملك، وفي الآخرة بالنار، وما لهم مِن ناصر ينصرهم ويدفع عنهم عذاب الله.

cards.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
cards.translation: Was nun diejenigen angeht, die ungläubig sind, so werde Ich sie im Diesseits und im Jenseits mit strenger Strafe strafen; und sie werden keine Helfer haben.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: Meaning of `Take You: Allah said, إِنِّي مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ (I will take you and raise you to Myself) while you are asleep. Allah said in a similar Ayat, وَهُوَ الَّذِى يَتَوَفَّـكُم بِالَّيْلِ (It is He Who takes your souls by night (when you are asleep).)

cards.headline: Was aber jene angeht, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:57
source.excerpt: وأما الذين آمنوا بالله ورسله وعملوا الأعمال الصالحة، فيعطيهم الله ثواب أعمالهم كاملا غير منقوص. والله لا يحب الظالمين بالشرك والكفر.

cards.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
cards.translation: Was aber jene angeht, die glauben und rechtschaffene Werke tun, so wird Er ihnen ihren Lohn in vollem Maß zukommen lassen. Und Allah liebt nicht die Ungerechten.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Diabetic retinopathy in Sub-Saharan Africa

source.title: Diabetic retinopathy in Sub-Saharan Africa: prevalence and regional variations from a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: About a quarter of diabetics in SSA have DR. This is similar to regional estimates (28% in East Africapubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) but slightly lower than the overall Africa average (~36%)pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov. The high heterogeneity suggests that the prevalence of DR is highly variable throughout SSA.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Gynecology and Obstetrics

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Gynecology and Obstetrics: Medico-Legal, Ethical, and Governance Challenges-A Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: Safe adoption requires more than technical accuracy. We translate the findings into seven actionable institutional requirements, namely accountable ownership, minimum local validation, role-specific training, auditable documentation, equity monitoring, post-deployment surveillance, and incident reporting. AI should augment-not displace-clinically accountable and relational care.

cards.headline: Laryngeal Anatomy and Morphometry

source.title: Laryngeal Anatomy and Morphometry: Foundations for Interdisciplinary Collaboration and Personalized Management of Laryngeal Pathology.
source.excerpt: Laryngeal morphometry should therefore become a routine decision-making framework for precision laryngology.

cards.headline: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review

source.title: Mathematical foundations of artificial intelligence in healthcare: a systematic review.
source.excerpt: Emerging approaches, including graph neural networks, Transformers, and quantum machine learning, require stronger external validation, standardized benchmarking, and rigorous evaluation for reliable clinical translation.

cards.headline: Blunted Niacin Skin Flushing Response in Schizophrenia: A Meta-analysis

source.title: Blunted Niacin Skin Flushing Response in Schizophrenia: A Meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: This study confirmed a significantly abnormal NSFR and higher prevalence of BNR in SZ, which highlights the potential facilitation of the diagnosis and personalized intervention of SZ subgroups. In addition, the study points to a need to establish a standardized method for NSFR assessment.

cards.headline: The role of artificial intelligence in urological malignancies

source.title: The role of artificial intelligence in urological malignancies: an overview of systematic reviews.
source.excerpt: AI-based models consistently demonstrate improved diagnostic and predictive performance across urological malignancies and hold promise for enhancing clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. At present, AI tools should be regarded as decision-support systems that complement, rather than replace, clinical expertise.

cards.headline: Decoding Social Cues

source.title: Decoding Social Cues: A Scoping Review of AI-Supported Emotional Competencies and Their Impact on School-Aged Populations.
source.excerpt: More longitudinal research is required, as well as more robust experimental designs that go beyond basic emotion models.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Contemporary Dentistry

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Contemporary Dentistry: Applications Across Dental Specialties and Future Challenges.
source.excerpt: These challenges include algorithm bias, data privacy concerns, the absence of regulatory guidelines for the development of such tools, and cost.

cards.headline: Association between blood lipid levels and preeclampsia: a meta-analysis

source.title: Association between blood lipid levels and preeclampsia: a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Patients with PE exhibit significant alterations in blood lipid levels, which are associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes. These associations persist after adjusting for BMI, although effect sizes are modest. Blood lipid monitoring may serve as a clinical reference in PE management, but causal inference is precluded due to the observational nature of the included studies.

cards.headline: Global Epidemiology and Risk Stratification of the Inferior Alveolar Nerve Anterior Loop

source.title: Global Epidemiology and Risk Stratification of the Inferior Alveolar Nerve Anterior Loop: A CBCT-Based Systematic Review with AI-Assisted Clustering.
source.excerpt: AI-assisted clustering may complement conventional evidence synthesis by identifying population-level anatomical patterns, although patient-level and external clinical validation is required.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Cardiovascular Medicine: Focus on Hypertension

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Cardiovascular Medicine: Focus on Hypertension.
source.excerpt: Realizing this potential will depend on rigorous validation, thoughtful implementation, and sustained alignment with clinical, ethical, and equity principles.

cards.headline: Adjunctive acupuncture for sepsis-associated acute gastrointestinal injury

source.title: Adjunctive acupuncture for sepsis-associated acute gastrointestinal injury: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and exploratory Bayesian network meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Current evidence suggests that acupuncture, when used as an adjunct to standard care, may improve gastrointestinal function and inflammatory profiles in patients with sepsis-associated AGI, but does not confer a clear survival benefit.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Urologic Documentation

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Urologic Documentation: A Review of Emerging Capabilities and the Ongoing Need for Human Oversight.
source.excerpt: Used as supervised drafting aids rather than autonomous authors, AI tools have the potential to ease documentation burden and create more time for direct patient care without diminishing the clinician's role in shaping the medical record.

cards.headline: Effectiveness of Mobile Health Interventions in Pediatric Cancer

source.title: Effectiveness of Mobile Health Interventions in Pediatric Cancer: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
source.excerpt: This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized evidence from RCTs. The findings support the use of mHealth to reduce infections and PICC-related complications among pediatric patients with cancer while improving quality of life, self-management capabilities, and treatment adherence.

cards.headline: Dies verlesen Wir dir von den Zeichen und den weisen Sprüchen.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:58
source.excerpt: ذلك الذي نقصُّه عليك في شأن عيسى، من الدلائل الواضحة على صحة رسالتك، وصحة القرآن الحكيم الذي يفصل بين الحق والباطل، فلا شك فيه ولا امتراء.

cards.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
cards.translation: Dies verlesen Wir dir von den Zeichen und den weisen Sprüchen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?

cards.headline: Gewiß, das Gleichnis ’Isas ist bei Allah wie das Gleichnis Adams. Er erschuf ihn aus Erde.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:59
source.excerpt: إنَّ خَلْقَ الله لعيسى من غير أب مثَلُه كمثل خلق الله لآدم من غير أب ولا أم، إذ خلقه من تراب الأرض، ثم قال له: «كن بشرًا» فكان. فدعوى إلهية عيسى لكونه خلق من غير أب دعوى باطلة; فآدم عليه السلام خلق من غير أب ولا أم، واتفق الجميع على أنه عَبْد من عباد الله.

cards.arabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
cards.translation: Gewiß, das Gleichnis ’Isas ist bei Allah wie das Gleichnis Adams. Er erschuf ihn aus Erde. Hierauf sagte Er zu ihm: Sei! und da war er.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
